(d) Investment in Moonshot AI Ltd (“Moonshot”) Moonshot is an artificial intelligence company in the PRC. During the year ended March 31, 2024, the Company invested a total of approximately US$ 0.8 billion (approximately RMB 5.9 billion) for an approximately 36 % equity interest. The investment in Moonshot is accounted for under the equity method.

In September 2019, we received a newly issued 33% equity interest (on a fully diluted basis) in Ant Group following the satisfaction of the closing conditions. As of March 31, 2025, we held 33% of Ant Group’s equity interest.
